info.name: Collabspace API
info.description: Set baseUrl if your port differs. Pick a file in the upload requests before running them. Folders run top to bottom; destructive requests are in the last folder. Run order: 1) Register  2) Register helper: second user  3) List teams  4) Create project  5) Add member  6) Create task, then the rest (comments, files, chat, meetings).

request.description: Creates a user with a fresh random email and stores the token in {{token}}.
Creates another user to use as a project member and saves its token in {{otherToken}} (used by the Notifications folder). Does NOT change {{token}}.
Always 200. The link arrives in Mailpit (http://localhost:8025).

item.name: Login with Google (needs a real Google ID token)

request.description: The frontend obtains the ID token from Google Sign-In and sends it here. The server verifies it (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, verified email).

exec: pm.test("200 with a real Google ID token, 401 with the placeholder, 503 if Google sign-in is not configured", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 401, 503]); });

request.description: Email is read-only in v1. availability_status: available | busy | away.
jpg, jpeg, png or webp, max 2 MB.
Excludes yourself. Matches name (contains) or exact email.
You become the leader. Optional: members[] with user_id, team_id, job_title, role.
PUT replaces: name, priority, status, start_date and end_date are required.
Creates or replaces the current user's update for today in UTC. Current project membership is required.

exec: pm.test("Includes the saved daily status", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.date).to.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/); });

request.description: Defaults to today in UTC. Current leaders see all project updates for the date and other members see their own.
Teams with members and tasks_done / tasks_total per member. Members without a team are in the 'Unassigned' group.
Run 'Register helper: second user' first. 422 if already a member.
The last leader cannot be demoted (422).
Any project member can create. status may be todo | in_progress | in_review (never completed).
Run 'Add member (leader)' first: assignees and the reviewer must be project members (422 otherwise).
Enable team_id to match tasks assigned to a member of that team in this project. Enable overdue=1 for open tasks due before today UTC.
Filter tasks in your projects by team_id, priority, status, assignment, or overdue=1 for open tasks due before today UTC.
Leader, creator or assignee. Never changes status or progress. Send assignee_ids[] to replace assignees.
progress applies only when the new status is in_progress.
Needs the reviewer if one is set (a leader can always). Completion forces progress = 100.

Max 10 MB. pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, png, jpg, jpeg, webp, txt, csv, md, json, sql, zip. Modern Office packages need the expected manifest and main part. task_id (optional) must belong to the same project.
Enable uploaded_by_me=1 to list files you uploaded in this project.
Enable uploaded_by_me=1 to list your uploads in projects you can access.
Use 'Send and Download' in Postman. Members only; always served as an attachment.
Project channels, team channels, and direct chats. Enable q to search visible conversations by project name, team name, or other participant name.
Allowed only if you share a project with the user (403 otherwise). Returns 200 if the chat already exists.
Enable q to search message bodies in this conversation. Keep q and per_page when following cursor links.
Select a file for the attachment field. Uses the project file whitelist, 10 MB limit, and modern Office package checks. Saves attachmentMessageId for the download request.

exec: pm.test("Message has an attachment", function () { pm.expect(message && message.attachment).to.be.an("object"); });

request.description: starts_at must be in the future. With project_id every participant must be a project member; without it participants must share a project with you. meeting_url must be https.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Design review",
  "starts_at": "{{startsAt}}",
  "duration_minutes": 30,
  "meeting_url": "https://meet.example.com/design-review",
  "note": "Goal: agree on the homepage layout.",
  "project_id": "{{projectId}}",
  "participant_ids": [
    "{{otherUserId}}"
  ]
}

request.description: Meetings where you are organizer or participant. This example covers the next seven UTC calendar dates, starting today.

{
  "title": "Design review (updated)",

  "duration_minutes": 30,
  "meeting_url": "https://meet.example.com/design-review",

  ]
}

request.description: Organizer and participants. speaker_id must be the organizer or a participant.
Needs at least one transcript entry (422 otherwise) and a configured AI provider (503 otherwise). Rate limit: 20/min.
Runs as the SECOND user ({{otherToken}}), who receives the notifications created by your earlier requests (added to a project, assigned a task, invited to a meeting). Includes unread_count.
Runs as the second user.
Runs as the second user.
Task counters (tasks assigned to me), active projects, recent files, my tasks, upcoming meetings and the yearly project overview.
period: today | week | month | three_months | year. Today uses midnight UTC through now and compares against the same hours yesterday. The chart keeps a month label.
type: project_progress | task_performance | team_activity. The stats are stored as a snapshot. project_id is optional.
Min 2 characters. Up to 5 projects, 5 tasks and 5 files, only inside your projects.
Needs AI_BASE_URL, AI_API_KEY and AI_MODEL in .env (OpenAI-compatible). Returns 503 when the AI is not configured. Max 4000 characters, 20 requests/min.
Leader or the task creator.
After running this, update the {{password}} collection variable to NewSecret123.
Paste the real token from the Mailpit email (http://localhost:8025) to get 200.
